sentences.l1: Many people take the bus to work.
In this way, there are fewer cars on the road.
With fewer cars, the air is good.
When the air is good, people are healthier.

sentences.l2: 开车会放出脏东西，让空气污染。
sentences.l1: Driving releases dirty things and makes the air polluted.
A bus can carry many people.

sentences.l2: 坐公交的人多，每个人的碳足迹就小。
sentences.l1: When many people take the bus, each person's carbon footprint is small.

sentences.l2: 碳足迹小，地球就更干净。
sentences.l1: When the carbon footprint is small, the earth is cleaner.

sentences.l2: 城市规划让公交线路方便。
sentences.l1: City planning makes bus routes convenient.

sentences.l2: 大家坐公交通勤，是环保的好习惯。
sentences.l1: Everyone commuting by bus is a good environmentally friendly habit.
